title: Implement SqliteLibrary: Library::get + Library::query
description:
Read operations for SqliteLibrary.

Library::get(id) → Result<Option<KnowledgeObject>, LibraryError>:
  SELECT from knowledge_objects WHERE id = ?, deserialize JSON blobs back into KnowledgeObject struct. Return None if not found.
  Note: signature may need updating from &KnowledgeObject to owned KnowledgeObject per sub-decisions issue #13.

Library::query(q) → Result<Vec<KnowledgeObjectId>, LibraryError>:
  Build a dynamic SQL query from the LibraryQuery fields (AND-combined filters):
  - content_type: WHERE content_type = ?
  - author: WHERE authors LIKE '%' || ? || '%' (JSON array, case-insensitive)
  - year_range: WHERE year BETWEEN ? AND ?
  - text_search: WHERE title LIKE ? OR abstract_text LIKE ? (basic, no FTS needed at M1)
  - limit: LIMIT ?
  Return Vec<KnowledgeObjectId> (IDs only; callers use get() to fetch full objects).

Unit tests:
  - get by ID: ingest → get → same title/authors/year.
  - get missing ID → None.
  - query by content_type: insert 2 academic_pdf + 1 web_article → query(academic_pdf) returns 2.
  - query by author substring: insert 'Vaswani' → query(author='Vaswani') returns it.
  - query with limit: insert 5 objects → query(limit=2) returns 2.

Acceptance criterion: all unit tests pass; cargo clippy clean.
